display.title: Authoritative Server — Tween & TriggerArea Capability Harness
display.description: Runs the SAME Tween + TriggerArea test suite twice — once on the headless authoritative server, once locally on the client — and shows the two verdicts side by side. A server that lacks the tween/trigger-area systems never writes TweenState / TriggerAreaResult, so every server column entry times out and fails while the client column passes: that CLIENT-pass / SERVER-fail split is the signal. Includes an always-on live rig (server-tweened platform entering a server-owned trigger zone) that needs BOTH features working server-side to ever register an entry, plus a tween-free canary that proves the trigger system alive on its own.
